subject: Insurance
title: Chatbot Claims Processing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Chatbot Claims Processing usable.

hook.text: Lemonade's AI chatbot Jim settled a claim in 3 seconds.

discovery.text: AI claims bots verify coverage, check for fraud patterns, and issue payment in a single automated pipeline.

twist.text: Speed creates new fraud opportunities. If claims are approved in seconds, there's no time for human skepticism.

climax.text: Instant claims processing trades thoroughness for speed.

punchline.text: 3-second claim settlement. Speed is great until fraud finds it.

quiz.question: How fast did Lemonade's AI chatbot settle a claim?
